steps.what: Observe ultrasound screen during scanning and adjust equipment for diagnostically satisfactory images

tasks.design: Retain live image-quality assessment and equipment adjustment at the ultrasound scanner {OTHER}. Native presets already in use support acquisition, but their existing runtime is not a new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: A satisfactory image depends on anatomy, artefacts, probe handling and the clinical question.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing scanner controls support acquisition without replacing the sonographer's judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising an artefact or incomplete view that could obscure an important finding.
tasks.human_edge: Adjusting acquisition in response to the actual image and patient.
tasks.altitude: Acquisition responsibility and monitoring time stay unchanged.

steps.what: Observe and care for patients throughout examinations, responding to safety and comfort needs

tasks.design: Keep patient observation and comfort support with the sonographer throughout the examination. Existing care notes in the clinical system {OTHER} can inform support but do not replace attention to the patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Distress and discomfort emerge through live interaction and may need immediate action.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing care information supports preparation without replacing bedside observation.
tasks.still_hard: Unspoken distress, changing tolerance and recognising when to stop or seek help.
tasks.human_edge: Noticing the patient's response and adapting care sensitively.
tasks.altitude: No reduction in patient-care responsibility or attention.

reach.task: Support patients with additional care needs

evidence.claim: Documentation and image-analysis products do not establish replacement of live patient safety and comfort support.

assumptions: Boundary is direct patient care during the examination, not separate image-quality judgement or record drafting. Patient and nurse time are excluded from the sonographer denominator and unchanged.
No machine consumes an assumed distress or comfort code; observation and response remain human.

steps.what: Review acquired sonograms and identify technical findings, measurements and examination limitations
Draft the written technical summary of sonogram findings for the physician

loop.purpose: Express the sonographer's checked findings as a technical summary
loop.input: Sonographer's dictated findings, verified measurements, image references and limitations
loop.output: Draft technical summary with source-linked measurements and explicit limitations
loop.check: Sonographer checks anatomical site, laterality, measurement units, uncertainty and correspondence with images; unsupported findings or diagnostic conclusions are removed
loop.stop: Missing image references, inconsistent measurements or unsupported statements require manual reporting; no unapproved summary is sent
loop.why_not_simpler: Native structured templates come first; varied technical observations may still need bounded narrative transformation

steps.what: Check and provide the final sonogram and technical summary to the physician

tasks.design: Use native ultrasound reporting templates and image references in the imaging system {OTHER} first. A bounded draft may express the sonographer's checked findings, while the sonographer verifies the exact image-summary pair and personally handles urgent or uncertain handover to the physician.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked technical findings can require repeated wording in a report.
tasks.enabler_now: Reviewed clinical narrative drafting exists; ultrasound-specific suitability and benefit still need validation.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving laterality, units, limitations and the distinction between technical findings and diagnosis.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing what was actually seen and communicating what the images cannot establish.
tasks.altitude: Potentially less wording for written summaries; acquisition, findings and clinical handover responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Interpret the images and technical findings
reach.learn: Which limitations need direct discussion rather than routine report text

evidence.claim: Autoscriber and the hospital speech-recognition example support clinician-reviewed narrative drafts; they do not establish ultrasound image interpretation or validated ultrasound reporting performance.
The70% remaining wording time and3-hour upkeep are provisional written-summary scenarios, not measured ultrasound results.

assumptions: Boundary starts after image acquisition and includes findings review, a written summary and handover. Purely oral summaries retain the existing process and earn no wording saving. Do not charge acquisition or image-quality checks again.

tasks.short: Decide whether to extend the examination

steps.what: Determine whether examination scope should be extended from findings and applicable protocol

tasks.design: Keep the examination protocol in {DOCS} beside current findings in the imaging system {OTHER}. The sonographer decides whether to extend within delegated authority and consults the physician when required; a protocol suggestion is not treated as an autonomous scope change.
tasks.previous_blocker: New findings can change what additional views are clinically useful.
tasks.enabler_now: Protocol access supports judgement without proving an automated extension decision.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected findings, incomplete views and balancing clinical value with patient tolerance.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a finding merits another view or a physician's direction.
tasks.altitude: Examination-scope authority stays within existing delegated limits.

reach.learn: Escalation thresholds and the diagnostic question

evidence.claim: The digest's MRI protocol selection study does not establish automated ultrasound examination-extension decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is the decision and required consultation about extension, not additional scanning or the physician's own time. No new decision rights are granted.
No machine consumes a free abnormality or extension-needed code; sonographer interprets original findings with full time retained.
Native protocol access comes first. Zero upkeep because no model or scope-control system is introduced.
unknowns: Delegated authority and physician consultation requirements
research_questions: Which findings require physician consultation rather than operator-led protocol extension?
